name: Standard works
passage_locator: Guide to the Scriptures: Standard Works
card_assertion: The Church names the Bible, Book of Mormon, Doctrine and Covenants and Pearl of Great Price as its standard works.

name: Resurrection testimony
card_assertion: Matthew 28 narrates the announcement that Jesus has risen, appearances to followers and a commission to teach and baptize.

name: Baptism at Mormon
card_assertion: Mosiah connects baptism with service, mourning with others and standing as witnesses of God.

name: Doctrine and Covenants
card_assertion: The Church presents this collection as modern revelations and declarations. Section 7 is specifically described as a translated record attributed to John.

name: Kolob
card_assertion: Abraham describes Kolob in a revelation about heavenly order and divine reckoning of time. This atlas does not identify it with an observed star.

name: Principles and ordinances
card_assertion: The fourth Article of Faith names faith in Jesus Christ, repentance, baptism by immersion and laying on of hands for the gift of the Holy Ghost.

name: Scripture and revelation
card_assertion: Articles of Faith 8–9 affirm the Bible, with a translation qualification, the Book of Mormon and continuing revelation.

name: Haran
card_assertion: Old Testament: Genesis describes Abram departing from Haran. Modern identification not adopted here.

name: Haran
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Abraham’s account describes departure from Haran. Modern identification not adopted here.

name: Shechem (Sichem)
card_assertion: Old Testament: the journey reaches the place called Sichem by the plain of Moreh. Modern archaeological identification pending.

name: Camp between Bethel and Hai
card_assertion: Old Testament: Abram pitches his tent between Bethel and Hai and builds an altar. The text gives Bethel to the west and Hai to the east; no pin.

name: Egypt
card_assertion: Old Testament: Genesis describes Abram travelling to Egypt during famine. No single city or point is asserted.

name: Horeb
card_assertion: Old Testament: Exodus places Moses’ encounter at the burning bush at Horeb. No Sinai candidate is adopted.

name: Ur of the Chaldees
card_assertion: Old Testament: Genesis describes Terah’s household leaving Ur for Canaan and settling in Haran. No proposed Ur is chosen.

name: Ur of the Chaldees
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Abraham describes leaving Ur with family members. No proposed Ur is chosen.

name: Mount of Olives
card_assertion: Old Testament: Zechariah’s prophecy names the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem.

name: Mount of Olives
card_assertion: New Testament: Matthew names the Mount of Olives in the Passion narrative.

name: Mount of Olives
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Joseph Smith—Matthew places Jesus’ conversation with his disciples on the Mount of Olives.

name: Gethsemane
card_assertion: New Testament: Matthew describes Jesus praying here before his arrest. No exact garden identification is adopted.

name: Golgotha
card_assertion: New Testament: Matthew names Golgotha as the place of crucifixion. No modern candidate is selected.

name: Waters of Mormon
card_assertion: Book of Mormon: Mosiah describes Alma teaching and baptizing at waters in the place called Mormon. Modern location unknown; not placed on the Earth map.

name: Temple in Bountiful
card_assertion: Book of Mormon: 3 Nephi places a gathered multitude at the temple in Bountiful when Jesus appears. Modern location unknown; distinct from the Bountiful on the Arabian shore in 1 Nephi.

name: Woods near the Smith home
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Joseph Smith’s canonized account describes a prayer in nearby woods and a vision of two personages, reported for spring 1820, near Manchester, New York. No grove point is sourced.

name: Enoch’s city (Zion)
card_assertion: Doctrine and Covenants: D&C 38:4 describes the Zion of Enoch as taken into God’s presence. No terrestrial location is supplied.

name: Enoch’s city (Zion)
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Moses 7 describes Enoch’s community as Zion and the city being taken up. No terrestrial location is supplied.

name: Jershon (Abraham)
card_assertion: Pearl of Great Price: Abraham names Jershon on the way from Haran to Canaan. Location unknown; not the Book of Mormon Jershon.

name: Abram’s journey
card_assertion: Genesis traces Abram’s movement from Haran into Canaan and then Egypt (Gen. 12:4–10).

name: Moses’ commission
card_assertion: At Horeb, Moses is commissioned to bring Israel out of Egypt (Ex. 3:1–12).

name: Baptisms at Mormon
card_assertion: Alma teaches baptismal commitments and baptizes at the waters of Mormon (Mosiah 18:7–17).

name: Jesus at Bountiful
card_assertion: The narrative describes Jesus appearing to the multitude at the temple (3 Ne. 11:1–17).

name: First Vision account
card_assertion: The D&C introduction reports Joseph Smith’s First Vision in spring 1820 while he was living in Manchester.

name: First Vision account
card_assertion: Joseph Smith’s canonized account in the Pearl of Great Price reports a vision following prayer in the woods.

name: Abraham’s journey account
card_assertion: Abraham describes a journey from Ur through Haran and Canaan toward Egypt (Abr. 2:4–21). It gives Abraham’s age on leaving Haran as 62; Genesis 12:4 gives 75. Neither value is corrected or harmonized here.
